FC620 / FC680: Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Wood Base
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-fc620-fc680-forte-lounge-chair-with-wood-base-n700158
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/forte-lounge-arm-chairs/
Spec sheets: FC620 / FC680 Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Wood Base, Forté Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Wood Base – FC620 / FC680
Current H1: Norix Forté Durable Lounge Chair with Wood Base - FC620 / FC680
Subtitle: Rotationally Molded Lounge Arm Chair on a Solid Hardwood Base, with Optional Upholstery, for Lounges and Waiting Areas
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture Forté Series FC620 Forté Lounge Chair with FC680 Molded Plinth Base
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Wood Base pairs a one-piece, rotationally molded lounge chair (FC620) with a solid hardwood base (FC680) for a warm, residential look in lounges and waiting areas. The arms give residents hand-over-ankle positioning for easier egress.
The base is a 3” solid hardwood frame with tapered legs and glued mortise and tenon joints, in Maple, Teak, or Walnut. Molded-in steel threaded inserts let you gang chairs side by side, and an optional bolt-down kit anchors the chair to the floor. An optional upholstered shell adds cushioning.
Seat: One-piece, rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers and a lightly textured, maintenance-free surface
TruColor Polymer: Fully compounded color for consistent color and durability
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Base: 3” solid hardwood frame with tapered legs and glued mortise and tenon joints
Ganging: Molded-in steel threaded inserts for optional side-to-side ganging
Optional Upholstery: Factory-installed upholstered plywood shell with polyurethane foam on the seat and back, double stitched with concealed staples; it can be removed for cleaning or replacement
Overall Size: 27”W×30.9”D×32.9”H
Seat Dimensions: 18.3” seat height and 21.9” seat width, with a 26.3” arm height
Weight: 44 lbs
Seat Colors: Twilight, Cove, Sage, Clay, Sand, or Dove; extended colors Citrus, Tranquil, Malibu, Cobalt, Wisteria, LUX Ivory, and LUX Onyx have a 6-piece minimum per color
Base Colors: Maple, Teak, or Walnut
Static Load Testing: Tested to 750 lbs
Performance Standards: Dynamic drop tested to twice the ANSI/BIFMA X5.4 impact force (250 lbs from 18”)
Flammability Standards (Not Upholstered): California Technical Bulletins 133 and 117; UL 1056; ASTM E1537; NFPA 261; UL 94 HB; BS 7176:2007 high hazard
Flammability Standards (Upholstered): California Technical Bulletin 117, with an optional TB133 upholstery upgrade
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for routine cleaning of the seat, which can also be cleaned with bleach and water solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants such as Virex, Wexcide, or Oxivir Five 16; a mild wood cleaner for the base; follow the fabric maker’s instructions for upholstery
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
FC620 / FC680 – Not Upholstered: Lounge arm chair on a wood base, 44 lbs
FC620 / FC680 – Upholstered (COM): Upholstered shell in customer’s own material (1.15 yards of fabric)
Options: Ganging kit (C011-021), bolt-down kit, and TB133 upholstery upgrade
Installation and Options
Assembly: None required
Ganging: Installation required for ganging plates
[H2] Applications
The Norix Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Wood Base suits lounges and waiting areas where a warmer, residential look matters, and where furniture still has to stand up to heavy use.
Typical applications include:
Lounges, family rooms, and visitation areas in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Lobbies and waiting rooms
Visitation rooms and staff areas in correctional and detention facilities
Transitional housing and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Transitional Housing Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Forté Furniture
Norix Forté is a designer series of seating and tables that brings comfort and a less institutional look to intensive-use rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The chairs and molded bases are rotationally molded from high-impact polyethylene with Norix TruColor polymer, and many pieces can be ballasted, bolted down, or ganged together.
The Forté series includes:
Guest Chairs: Guest arm and armless chairs, with or without upholstery
Lounge Chairs: Lounge arm and armless chairs on a molded plinth base or a solid hardwood base, with or without upholstery
Café Tables: A 36” round molded table, 42” and 48” round and 42” square laminate tops, and a 42” square DuoForm top, all on a molded hourglass base
Occasional Tables: 27” square laminate-top tables on a molded or wood base, which can be ganged with lounge chairs as intermediate or corner tables
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: same "About Norix Forté Furniture" section as the FC600 tab.
PHOTOS: all 3 chair photos on our page show the ARMLESS lounge chair (Norix FC630), not the FC620 arm chair. Norix has FC620 arm chair photos on the wood base (600×600): Twilight/Maple, Twilight/Teak, Sage/Maple, Sand/Teak, Clay/Teak, and Cove/Teak. Would you like me to replace the armless photos with these, or add them and keep the old ones?
BALLAST: the current page says the chair is "Ballast-able up to 100 pounds" with a "push-in cap" ballast port, but the wood base spec sheet has no ballasting and the price list shows ballasting as "N/A" for the wood base. Removed.
Removed from the current page: "Anti-ligature design with no internal openings." This is on the molded base spec sheet, not the wood base one.
Colors and subtitle: the current page lists the seat colors as "Twilight, Sage, Clay, Sienna, Dove, Raven" (seat and molded base colors mixed), and the current subtitle says "FC680 Molded Plinth Base," but the FC680 is the wood base. Corrected to seat colors Twilight, Cove, Sage, Clay, Sand, and Dove, and base colors Maple, Teak, and Walnut.
Prices checked: $994.40 (not upholstered) and $1,410.40 (upholstered, COM) are 80% of the Norix list prices of $1,243 and $1,763 (compare-at $1,243 and $1,763). No change.
Upholstered variant: our page sells only the COM version. The price list also has fabric grades B through H ($1,794 to $1,977 list). Would you like those as variants? If yes, please give me the SKUs.
Options: the price list shows the ganging kit (C011-021) at $83, the bolt-down plate at $87, and the TB133 upholstery upgrade at $112 (list). They are in the text but are not variants. Would you like any of them as variants?
Weight and size match the spec sheet and the worksheet (rows 199-200: 44 / 30.9 / 27 / 32.9).
Meta title: "with Wood Base" did not fit with "at Anchortex," so the meta title uses the model numbers to tell it apart from the molded base chair.
Collections: the chair is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, Transitional Housing, and Norix Furniture. I added a Transitional Housing Furniture link, since all seven Forté products are in that collection.
Removed: the long old series paragraph and the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the new Forté section and the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
